build.description: Build the demo page into dist/. Hoisted node_modules keep lazy chunks out of dot directories, which GitHub Pages artifacts drop.
build.command: rm -rf dist && deno install --node-modules-dir=manual --node-modules-linker=hoisted && deno bundle --platform browser --minify --node-modules-dir=manual --node-modules-linker=hoisted --outdir dist demo/index.html
